NEW_RELIC_API_KEY: newrelic nerdgraph query '{ actor { user { name } } }' sends one POST https://api.newrelic.com/graphql with Api-Key: <key>, newrelic-cli/0.117.0's User-Agent and the query, and prints the data; nrql query sends one NerdGraph request with the NRQL and prints the results; NEW_RELIC_REGION=EU goes to api.eu.newrelic.com; a refused key exits 1 with the 401 after one request (checklist.mjs)

newrelic profile add with every value as a flag stores the keys in ~/.newrelic/credentials.json, 0600 in a 0700 directory owned by the user, without a request; another user's cat of it fails; the profile becomes the default and the next nerdgraph query sends its key; config set writes config.json 0600; a value left to a prompt (no --accountId, no -y) fails at once with 'cannot prompt: WASI preview1 has no terminal raw mode', with no question or cursor query written (config.mjs)
